criteria.interpretation: This single-fixture wording diagnostic cannot establish broad reliability; if it supports the hypothesis, a separate frozen multi-fixture/held-out test is required.
criteria.irrelevant_control: Both seeds should say unknown with no target path.
criteria.latent_target_support: Both seeds for latent_A and latent_B must provide the respective answer and complete path to count as replicated positive; any one-seed result is provisional only.
criteria.no_bank_control: Both seeds should say unknown absent the bank.
criteria.visible_control: Both seeds should answer Beka with the expected path.
